name: Super Sales India Limited
about: Super Sales India Limited manufactures and sells yarns in India, Australia, Bangladesh, Brazil, Canada, Egypt, France, Italy, South Korea, Switzerland, the United States, and the United Arab Emirates. It operates through three segments: Agency, Textiles, and Engineering. The company sells machinery and equipment, such as blow rooms, auto blend, ring frame auto piecing, cards, CDS, draw frames, lap former, combers, speed and smart ring frames, and spinpact. It also provides cotton yarns, including hosiery, weaving, siro compact, weaving, knitting, and TFO doubled yarns. In addition, the company offers various spur, helical, worm, bevel, and ring gears; timing belt pulleys; and various gear boxes. It serves construction, cement, textile, recycling, paper, steel, food, mining, material handling, sugar, power, rubber, plastic, crane, chemical, packaging, foundry, and agriculture industries. The company was formerly known as Super Sales Agencies Limited and changed its name to Super Sales India Limited in 2005. Super Sales India Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Coimbatore, India.
